items.title: Stella issues rivals warning over McLaren 'momentum' in title battles
items.description: McLaren boss Andrea Stella has issued a warning to his team's rivals for the remainder of the 2026 season as he expressed confidence in the Woking squad's ability to maintain momentum once it has been gained.

items.title: Amazon founder Bezos nears deal to buy stake in Liverpool
items.description: Sky News understands a consortium including the Amazon founder Jeff Bezos is closing in on a deal to buy a roughly one-third stake in Liverpool.

items.title: Rangers frustrations, Celtic's Hogh silences critics, Hearts win under Wrancken
items.description: Rangers manager Derek McInnes is still waiting for his first win, but both Celtic striker Kasper Hogh and Hearts boss Wouter Vrancken answered some of their critics.

items.title: Super League's Final Charge: Play-off spots taking shape with five rounds left
items.description: There are just five rounds of Super League action remaining and, with it, a whole lot of drama as Super League's Final Charge ramps up.

items.title: UEFA signs joint letter slamming 'deception' as Infantino fallout continues
items.description: UEFA, CONMEBOL and AFC have hit out at "deception" and a "fundamental breach of trust" around Gianni Infantino's botched World Cup stake sale plans to further raise the pressure on the under-fire FIFA president.

items.title: Hearts thump Dundee United for Vrancken's first win
items.description: Hearts fire four past Dundee United in the Scottish Premiership as head coach Wouter Vrancken earns his first victory at the fifth attempt.
